subject: Genetics
title: DNA Repair Systems
description: A quick win: understand DNA Repair Systems.

hook.text: Your DNA suffers 100,000 lesions every single day. You're alive because repair enzymes fix nearly all of them.

buildup.text: Mismatch repair catches copying errors. Nucleotide excision repair cuts out UV damage. Base excision fixes oxidation.

discovery.text: When repair genes themselves mutate, cancer risk soars. BRCA1 mutations disable repair, increasing breast cancer risk.

twist.text: Some bacteria evolved to turn OFF repair during stress, increasing mutation rates to find survival solutions.

climax.text: Repair systems are evolution's editor. Without them, life would drown in errors within a single generation.

punchline.text: Life doesn't avoid damage. It just fixes it fast.

quiz.question: What happens when DNA repair genes like BRCA1 mutate?
